name: Karhu
verdict: Owned by Karhu Holding B.V. (majority owners Huub Valkenburg and Jay Duke, per a 2008 report). Nothing found.
note: MotoGP partner of SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team per trackhouse.com/partners (checked 2026-10-03 via Wayback Machine). Ownership: the Karhu brand was sold in 2008 to Karhu Holding B.V., majority-owned by Huub Valkenburg and Jay Duke (SGB Media, 2008-06-25); the ownership report dates from 2008 and no later change was found (checked 2026-10-03). No human-rights finding found against the company.
